description.narrative: The project will develop the water resources and promote improved management practices to increase and protect incomes and livelihoods of people in the poorest provinces of the central region. The components are: (i) irrigation and development; (ii) institutional support for system management and agricultural extension.

description.narrative: Increased agricultural production in the selected irrigation subprojects.

- subsidies to irrigation management companies (IMCs) reduced by at least 20% from current levels Progress/Status: Partly achieved, as subsidies already reduced on average by 20% but subsidies for Thach Thanh IMC increased 34%. Data Source: Project completion report Performance monitoring surveys Feedback from water users Financial records of IMCs Actual value:

Improved performance of irrigated agriculture in the selected subprojects: - area commanded and served in aequate and timely manner increased to 95% of potential; Progress/Status: Still too early to assess as 3 subprojects were just physically completed and other 3 subprojects are not completed yet. Data Source: Project completion report Performance monitoring surveys Feedback from water users Financial records of IMCs Actual value:

- maintenance performed on 95% of commanded area; Progress/Status: Still too early to assess as 3 subprojects were just physically completed and other 3 subprojects are not completed yet. Data Source: Project completion report Performance monitoring surveys Feedback from water users Financial records of IMCs Actual value:

- collection of water user fees increased to 95% of target; Progress/Status: Achieved more than target, as collection of water user fees of WUGs increased to 100% of target. Data Source: Project completion report Performance monitoring surveys Feedback from water users Financial records of IMCs Actual value:
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: 1. Irrigation management systems improved in the selected subprojects Indicator: Annual work plans prepared and approved Progress/Status: Work plans were prepared and approved annually. Data Source: Annual work plans and Report Baseline value: n Baseline value: n Target year: 2012 Target value: y

Output: 1. Irrigation management systems improved in the selected subprojects Indicator: Effective participatory irrigation management (PIM) operating for all subproject areas by completion of physical works Progress/Status: Still too early to assess as 3 subprojects were just physically completed and other 3 subprojects are not completed yet. Data Source: Reports of nongovernment organizations (NGOs) and other institutions contracted to help form WUGs/WUAs Training reports Baseline value: n Baseline value: n Target year: 2012 Target value: y

Output: 1. Data Source: Approved IMC business plans Audited IMC annual accounts Baseline value: n Baseline value: n Target year: 2012 Target value: y

Output: 1. Data Source: Provincial and Commune Statistics Minutes of WUG/WUA meetings Target year: 2012 Target value: 66

Output: 1.
